床旗

Tā shì Měng gǔ yuán sù, suǒ yǐ ne

Tā xiě le “yīng xióng shàng mǎ de dì fang”

Nà zài jiā shàng tā zhè yí ge
那再加上它这一个

“Yīng xióng shàng mǎ de dì fang” de bào zhěn

Yì qǐ pèi duì
一起配对

Zhè yàng de huà, xiǎn de zhěng ge
这样的话显得整个

Bái sè de chuáng pǐn jiù bú zài nà me de dān diào
白色的床品就不再那么的单调

Yǒu yì zhǒng zì jǐ de tè sè le
有一种自己的特色了

Jiù shì gé zāng

我们没有

穿睡衣睡裤

Wǒ men kě yǐ zuò zài zhè ge shàng miàn
我们可以坐在这个上面

Chuān zhe wài kù zuò zài shàng miàn
穿着外裤坐在上面

Yǒu shí hou yě kě yǐ fàng yì xiē lín shí de dōng xi
有时候也可以放一些临时的东西

Bǐ rú shuō nǐ diǎn le wài mài a
比如说你点了外卖啊

Fàng shàng qu, fàng shàng qu
放上去放上去

Jiù bú huì bǎ nǐ de zhè ge bèi zi nòng zāng le
就不会把你的这个被子弄脏了

晚上睡觉的时候你就

你踢开这个被角

en_cues.text:
Gěi dà jiā jiè shào yí xià zhè ge shì shén me
给大家介绍一下这个是什么
Let me show you what this is.

Chuáng qí
床旗
A bed runner.

Yě jiào chuáng wěi jīn
也叫床尾巾
It's also called a bed scarf.

Yīn wèi wǒ men zhù de jiǔ diàn shì Nèi Měng gǔ de jiǔ diàn
因为我们住的酒店是内蒙古的酒店
We're staying at a hotel in Inner Mongolia.

Měng gǔ yuán sù fēi cháng zhòng
蒙古元素非常重
It has a strong Mongolian theme.

Suǒ yǐ tā zhè ge chuáng qí
所以它这个床旗
So, on this bed runner,

Shàng miàn xiě le
上面写了  
it says,

“Yīng xióng shàng mǎ de dì fang”
  “英雄上马的地方”
“Where heroes mount their horses.”

Nà zhè ge “yīng xióng” shì shéi le
那这个"英雄"是谁了
So who is this “hero”?

Nǐ men yě zhī dào
你们也知道
You probably know, too.

Yě lèi bǐ nǎ xiē rén
也类比哪些人
And who else could it refer to?

Wèi shén me yǒu de jiǔ diàn huò zhě jiā lǐ
为什么有的酒店或者家里
Why do some hotels and households

Tā men xǐ huan fàng chuáng qí / chuáng wěi jīn ne
他们喜欢放床旗/床尾巾呢
like to use bed runners or bed scarves?

Zhǔ yào yǒu jǐ ge zuò yòng, dì yī
主要有几个作用第一
They have a few main uses. First,

Jiù shì zhuāng shì
就是装饰
they're decorative.

Yì bān jiǔ diàn dōu shì bái sè de
一般酒店都是白色的
Hotels usually use white bedding,

Chún bái sè de chuáng pǐn
纯白色的床品
plain white bedding.

Xiǎn de gān jìng
显得干净
It looks clean.

Dàn shì ne, chún bái sè yòu hěn dān diào
但是呢纯白色又很单调
But plain white can also look rather dull.

Jiù bǐ rú shuō wǒ men jīn tiān zhù de zhè ge jiǔ diàn
就比如说我们今天住的这个酒店
Take the hotel we're staying at today.

Tā shì Měng gǔ yuán sù, suǒ yǐ ne
它是蒙古元素所以呢
It has a Mongolian theme, so

Tā xiě le “yīng xióng shàng mǎ de dì fang”
它写了“英雄上马的地方”
it says, “Where heroes mount their horses.”

Nà zài jiā shàng tā zhè yí ge
那再加上它这一个
And then there's this

“Yīng xióng shàng mǎ de dì fang” de bào zhěn
“英雄上马的地方”的抱枕
“Where heroes mount their horses” cushion.

Yì qǐ pèi duì
一起配对
They make a matching set.

Zhè yàng de huà, xiǎn de zhěng ge
这样的话显得整个
That way, all the

Bái sè de chuáng pǐn jiù bú zài nà me de dān diào
白色的床品就不再那么的单调
white bedding doesn't look so dull anymore.

Yǒu yì zhǒng zì jǐ de tè sè le
有一种自己的特色了
It has a character of its own.

Dì yī ge jiù shì qǐ dào zhuāng shì de zuò yòng
第一个就是起到装饰的作用
So the first use is decoration.

Dì èr ge ne
第二个呢
The second use

Jiù shì gé zāng
就是隔脏
is to keep the bedding clean.

Yǒu shí hou wǒ men gāng jìn jiǔ diàn
有时候我们刚进酒店
Sometimes, when we first arrive at a hotel,

Nà wǒ men de bāo fàng zài nǎ lǐ
那我们的包放在哪里
where do we put our bags?

Kě yǐ fàng zài chuáng qí shàng
可以放在床旗上
We can put them on the bed runner.

Nà wǒ men zuò zài nǎ lǐ ne
那我们坐在哪里呢
And where can we sit?

Wǒ men méi yǒu
我们没有
We haven't

Chuān shuì yī shuì kù
穿睡衣睡裤
changed into our pajamas.

Wǒ men kě yǐ zuò zài zhè ge shàng miàn
我们可以坐在这个上面
We can sit on this,

Chuān zhe wài kù zuò zài shàng miàn
穿着外裤坐在上面
still wearing our outdoor trousers.

Yǒu shí hou yě kě yǐ fàng yì xiē lín shí de dōng xi
有时候也可以放一些临时的东西
You can also set things on it temporarily.

Bǐ rú shuō nǐ diǎn le wài mài a
比如说你点了外卖啊
For example, if you've ordered takeout,

Fàng shàng qu, fàng shàng qu
放上去放上去
put it on here, on here.

Jiù bú huì bǎ nǐ de zhè ge bèi zi nòng zāng le
就不会把你的这个被子弄脏了
That way, you won't get your duvet dirty.

Wǎn shang shuì jiào de shí hou nǐ jiù
晚上睡觉的时候你就
Then, when you go to bed at night,

Bú huì gǎn jué bù shū fu le
不会感觉不舒服了
you won't feel uncomfortable.

Hái yǒu yì zhǒng zuò yòng
还有一种作用
There's one more use.

Tā men shuō shì zhè ge chuáng qí a, tā huì
他们说是这个床旗啊它会
They say this bed runner can

Jiù shì zhè ge bèi jiǎo, bǎ nǐ de bèi jiǎo yā zhù
就是这个被角,把你的被角压住
weigh down the corners of your duvet,

Yǐ fáng nǐ wǎn shang shuì jiào de shí hou
以防你晚上睡觉的时候
so that while you're asleep at night,

Nǐ tī kāi zhè ge bèi jiǎo
你踢开这个被角
you don't kick the corners off.

Dàn shì wǒ jué de zhè ge zuò yòng ba
但是我觉得这个作用吧
But I think its effect in that respect

Wēi hū qí wēi
微乎其微
is negligible.

Nǐ men de jiā lǐ yǒu chuáng qí ma
你们的家里有床旗吗
Do you have a bed runner at home?

Nǐ men de jiā lǐ yǒu chuáng wěi jīn ma
你们的家里有床尾巾吗
Do you have a bed scarf at home?

Píng lùn liú yán gào su wǒ
评论留言告诉我
Leave a comment and let me know.

Nǐ men xǐ huan bù xǐ huan
你们喜欢不喜欢
Do you like them?
